name: figma-hero
title: Figma Hero
description: Inspired by the David Suárez portfolio — a hero staged as a live Figma canvas. Hovering any text reveals a real selection box with blue outline, corner handles, and a "Text" layer tag. A custom black arrow cursor labelled "You" replaces the pointer while a purple "David" collaborator cursor wanders the canvas on its own with organic wobble. The middle name renders as a glitchy bitmap, re-shuffling its pixel palette every 700ms on a canvas element. Includes a live NYC clock, vertical column guides, and staggered fade-up entrance on the four hero blocks.
